h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Odisha

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Odisha

items.pText: Odisha has a long Bay of Bengal coastline, an industrial belt in the north and west, and hill districts in the south. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to all three, for schools, housing societies, municipal parks, steel and mining townships, beach resorts and temple town gardens.

Bhubaneswar and Cuttack bring most of our enquiries from housing projects, private schools and city parks. Rourkela is a steel township with planned colonies and company schools. Sambalpur, in the west, has colleges, schools and town parks, and Berhampur and Gopalpur in the south have schools, beach-side hotels and coastal homes. Puri adds pilgrimage crowds and seaside hotels. Every order is built at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sent by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India installs it, self-standing or grouted. Share the site size, the age group and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Coast, cyclones and the hot interior

c: Along the coast, from Balasore down to Gopalpur, salt air and humidity attack bare steel, and cyclones bring strong wind and flooding. Our posts are galvanised and most panels are roto-moulded, which suits sea air. On coastal sites we suggest grouted foundations rather than self-standing ones, and a play area raised above the level where water collects after a storm.

items.q: Is your equipment suitable for beach resorts on the Odisha coast?
items.a: Yes. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are corrosion-resistant. Rinse equipment near the sea with fresh water now and then, and check fittings after every cyclone or storm.

items.q: Which foundation should we use in a cyclone-prone area?
items.a: Grouting is the firmer choice where strong wind and flooding are expected. Our team or dealer looks at the ground and confirms the method before installation.

items.q: Can you plan playgrounds for a steel or mining township?
items.a: Yes. Townships often have several parks and schools, and we can plan them together with a layout drawing for each site. Send the site plans and the age groups for each park.
